title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1973-03-15
lineage: composite source 1: AUD>??>CD>EAC>SHN and source 2: SBD>MR>C>D>CD>EAC>SHN

ai_review.summary: Rough‑diamond matrix recording with a mixed‑energy show – stellar jams on The Other One, Eyes of the World and China Doll offset by poor audience sections.
ai_review.review: The performance captures a historically charged night (the first after Pigpen’s death) with high‑octane improvisations—especially the monster The Other One and a soaring Eyes of the World that many reviewers call a highlight.  Technically the tape is a matrix of soundboard and audience: the SBD portions are listenable despite splices and occasional distortion, while the AUD sections are often muddy or drop out.

ai_rating.rationale: Average overall star rating (≈3.4) with many reviewers praising the jams but repeatedly noting poor audience sound and occasional mix glitches, leading to a modest combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tracks are described as "worst" and often unusable; the soundboard is decent but has splice artifacts in Eyes, slight vocal distortion on Truckin' / Other One, and occasional channel drops. Overall listenable for fans who can tolerate the flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Band played in a circle, focusing inward after Pigpen’s death; first set felt subdued, while the second set built into extended jams (Truckin' > Other One > Eyes > China Doll) that lifted the energy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers note Jerry’s “meltdown” jams, spacey leads and animated playing on The Other One and Eyes of the World.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil is praised for “loads of Phil,” strong bass lines during the second‑set jams, and being especially animated in the climactic sections.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s keyboard work is highlighted as giving spacey texture to the jams; his modulation is mentioned alongside Jerry’s leads.
band_member_comments.Drums: Intense drumming is repeatedly cited as a driving force for the jam-heavy second set.
